upcomingSession.title: The Art of Ethiopian Naturals
upcomingSession.venue: The HUB Addis / Cashmere Events Space, Bole, Addis Ababa
upcomingSession.topic: Origin, processing, and the taste of place

speaker.name: Hanna Neuschwander
speaker.bio: A specialty coffee educator with 15+ years working alongside Ethiopian producers, exploring how processing shapes the cup.

upcomingSession.description: Ethiopian naturals are among the most expressive coffees in the world. In this session we taste through five single-origin lots, break down processing at origin, and discuss what makes each region unmistakable.
